reviewed_by: Codex review of failed 3.0.4 release WebKit policy journey
reason: The 3.0.4 release preparation failed the project authorization mode journey on wide mobile WebKit after retries because Playwright's direct radio and checkbox control clicks did not leave the controls selected during scrolling. The test now taps the visible label text, which matches the operator interaction, and asserts both resulting states. Run this exact journey on desktop, small mobile Chromium, and wide mobile WebKit.
exclusions: Only a Playwright interaction changed. Python, frontend unit, native, unrelated browser journeys, and full suites are excluded. Mobile browsers are emulated; physical-device evidence is unavailable.
